sentences.text: Star vs. the Forces of Evil is an American animated television series produced by Disney Television Animation .	Disney Television Animation	Disney Television Animation

The first episode was shown on January 18 , 2015 , on Disney Channel as a special preview , and the series officially premiered on March 30 , 2015 , on Disney XD .	Disney XD	Disney XD	Disney Channel	Disney Channel
The show was created by Daron Nefcy , who had worked on storyboards for Wander Over Yonder and Robot and Monster .	Wander Over Yonder	Wander Over Yonder	Robot and Monster	Robot and Monster

Nefcy became the second woman to create an animated series for Disney Television Animation -LRB- the first being Sue Rose , who created Pepper Ann -RRB- , and the first woman to create a Disney XD series .	Disney Television Animation	Disney Television Animation	Disney XD	Disney XD	Sue Rose	Sue Rose	Pepper Ann	Pepper Ann
On February 12 , 2015 , Disney renewed the series for a second season prior to its premiere on Disney XD .	Disney XD	Disney XD
The second season premiered on July 11 , 2016 .
On March 4 , 2016 , it was renewed for a third season , and on February 28 , 2017 , it was officially renewed for a fourth season .
